content:
amanda: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — summarizing action items for the missing spans / bad aggregation / ETL lag incident. I want clear owners, short timelines, and one weekly check-in until all fixes are in prod.

amanda: Root symptoms we saw: missing spans for ~10% of traces (span_id dropped during enrichment), aggregator double-counting for some session metrics (GROUP BY bug), and the nightly ETL lag that caused a backlog of ~32k rows.

raj: I can own the ETL lag remediation. Immediate plan: fast mitigations this week (backpressure tuning + parallel importer), longer fix is redesigning the commit checkpoint to avoid stalls.

liam: I will take the aggregation correctness. I reproduced the double-count on a subset and found the query was grouping on partition_id instead of trace_id. PR coming with tests.

amanda: Thanks — can we get ETAs? Raj, one for mitigation, one for the redesign. Liam, one for the PR + perf regression check. Sophia, will you own span propagation changes?

raj: Mitigation ETA: 2026-03-30 (config + deploy). Redesign spike/arch doc by 2026-04-07, full rollout target 2026-05-05. Opening ticket RDW-4237 now.

liam: PR by EOD tomorrow (1782560000). Perf tests by 2026-03-29. Ticket RDW-4241.

sophia: Yep I'll own span propagation. Root cause: our enrichment step overwrites parent_id when a tag is missing. I'll add guard logic and augment unit + integration tests. Targeting 2026-03-31 for PR. Ticket RDW-4242.

amanda: Nice. I'm assigning owners in the postmortem doc. For visibility, please paste short links to PRs/tickets in this thread when created. I'll run weekly check-ins (Thurs 11am PT) until all items closed.

liam: Quick snippet showing the bug that caused aggregation errors:
```sql
SELECT trace_id, SUM(duration) as total_dur
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= $start
GROUP BY partition_id -- should be GROUP BY trace_id
```

sophia: Also adding a small log example for span loss:
```
INFO enrichment: received span {trace_id=abc123, span_id=sp1}; enrichment_result: {parent_id=null} -> write span with parent_id=span_id (bug)
```

raj: Observed backlog metrics during the lag window: ingestion_queue_length peak=32,480, avg_consumer_lag=4.6m. We should add a one-off retry drain job for the backlog as a stopgap. Will schedule.

observability-bot: recurring-pattern-detect: The last 3 similar incidents show the same ETL backlog + aggregation mismatch pattern. Flagging for process follow-up. :warning:

amanda: Good catch @observability-bot. That suggests we need a runbook change and a rule in alerts to catch the aggregation count mismatch earlier. I'll draft runbook items and a new alert (ratio of processed_rows to expected_rows < 0.92).

raj: I'll add a dashboard with warm-up checks for the importer and a synthetic metric for queue drain time.

liam: Once my PR is up I'll include a small regression test that loads a canned dataset to assert counts, add to ci/integration.

sophia: Will add a trace-level unit test to ensure enrichment does not mutate parent/span ids.

amanda: Great. Action summary and owners (for the postmortem doc):
- RDW-4237 (raj): ETL mitigations + redesign spike. mitigation 2026-03-30, spike 2026-04-07.
- RDW-4241 (liam): Aggregation fix PR + perf tests. PR by 2026-03-25, perf by 2026-03-29.
- RDW-4242 (sophia): Span propagation guard + tests. PR by 2026-03-31.
- AMANDA (amanda): Runbook + alert updates, weekly check-ins (Thurs 11am PT).

amanda: Please reply with :thumbsup: when you acknowledge your assignments or update this thread with any schedule changes. I'll close the postmortem follow-up when all tickets are resolved and validated in prod.

raj: :thumbsup: created RDW-4237, added preliminary notes and raw backlog numbers.

liam: :thumbsup: PR draft up at github.com/redwood/reports/pull/512 — tests still running.

sophia: :thumbsup: RDW-4242 created, adding tests now.

amanda: Thanks everyone — ping me if anything slips. Next check-in 2026-03-26 11:00 PT.

observability-bot: reminder scheduled: next follow-up meeting in 7 days (2026-03-26 11:00 PT).
